name: laravel-production-audit
description: Production-readiness audit for Laravel apps: findings that cite file:line, plus ready-to-use production config.

plugins.name: laravel-production-audit
plugins.description: Audit an existing Laravel 13 / PHP 8.4 app for production readiness — performance, memory footprint, reliability, concurrency, and tenancy isolation — then generate production-ready config files (Horizon, PHP-FPM, OPcache, Nginx, Supervisor, Redis).
